To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) whole cell responses are controlled by a balance between higher level subcellular processes; and 2) imbalances between these higher level subcelluar processes can terminate whole cell response such as neurite growth.
the dynamic balance between vesicle exocytic and microtubular growth activities controls neurite outgrowth and imbalances can lead to the formation dystrophic bulbs.

(i) the balance between vesicle exocytic activity and microtubular growth is essential to neurite outgrowth; and (ii) imbalances in this balance lead to aberrant growth of neurites, resulting in formation of dystrophic bulb.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding how whole cell dynamics emerges from the dynamics of multiple SCPs.
understanding the mechanisms of how neurons grow neurites and form synapses and the role of imbalanced dynamics of subcellular processes in neurodegeneration.
understanding how balance between SCP dynamics controls the dynamics of higher level cellular responses such as neurites outgrowth.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
whole cell responses are the result of the balance between the higher level SCPs and imbalances between them lead to termination of the response.
the balance between the higher level SCPs is critical for neurite growth.
a balance between higher level SCPs is necessary for whole cell responses.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the balance of the activities of the SCPs is critical for the whole cell responses and that the formation of dystrophy bulbs is due to imbalances in activities of SCPs.
the balance between SCPs is critical to the whole cell response.
whole cell dynamics are a result of the dynamic balance between multiple SCPs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
quantitative imbalances between high level SCPs can lead to termination of whole cell dynamics.
whole cell dynamics can be understood as a result of a balance of multiple SCPs and imbalances in these SCPs can lead to aberrant whole cell responses such a dystrophic bulb formation.
whole cell dynamics are not the result of the sum of the dynamics of the individual SCps but rather are the result of the balance between them.
